name: data-scientist
description: Five skills for data scientists: ds-frame, ds-explore, ds-dataset, ds-evaluate and ds-experiment. They decide before modelling whether a rule, a score or a real model should be built, explore what in a table relates to the target, audit a training set for leakage, compare models from files of predictions so noise is called noise, and read A/B tests so a broken split or a win that does not survive correction cannot pass. Each computes with its own scripts and ends in one self-contained web page.
